title: Figure 3: HSVS hypersonic cruise aircraft, McDonnell Advanced Design drawing and painting
description: Composite of a black-and-white perspective line drawing of a slender hypersonic aircraft (top left) and a color artist's painting of the same type of vehicle in flight labeled "Mach 12 Cruise," with its skin shaded orange. Overlay text reads "McDonnell Aircraft Advanced Design Dept. 1958 to 1967 Mr. H. D. Altis, Director." Caption: "Figure 3. HSVS Hypersonic Cruise Aircraft Showing True Skin Temperature."
